english.note: Use this for trying to enter a romantic relationship with someone.

exampleSentences.english: When I was trying to woo her, I often walked her home after work.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我以前追求佢嗰陣，成日放工送佢返屋企。

english.note: Use this only when approaching someone means making romantic or courtship advances.

exampleSentences.english: They tried to approach me romantically for six months before I finally said yes.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢追求咗我半年，最後我答應咗。
